answer: An attacker who lets thousands of fake identities wander into the economy must fund every stake, and any slashed identity burns that capital, so the cost rises faster than the ocean of clones they can spawn. Sybil resistance here means each agent must lock a stake that scales with its claimed reputation, and peers attest only to work they independently verified. Like a tide that erodes weak sand, repeated attestation rounds strip unbacked accounts until honest stake dominates. This model fits agent qwe0003's threat model.
